# 207 Studio: full reference

> https://207studio.dev · support@207studio.dev · South Korea.

## Pairy: Connecting Devices (iOS/iPadOS app)

https://apps.apple.com/app/id6815584225 - remote desktop for your tablet. Paid app, one-time purchase ($4.99 in the US).
Page: https://207studio.dev/pairy/ (how it works, screenshots, the Mac companion download)

## Pairy for Mac 1.4.2 (build 142)

Download: https://github.com/207studio/207studio.github.io/releases/download/pairy-mac-1.4.2-142/Pairy-mac-1.4.2-142-notarized.zip

Apple Silicon only, macOS 15 or later. Notarized with Developer ID.

File: Pairy-mac-1.4.2-142-notarized.zip (22075699 bytes)
SHA-256: 38584e50e1963fd45369ebe496bce3324515651f1f81946a5248dcca23fc1ded

Double-click the zip to unzip it, then move PairyMac.app into Applications.

## In development

- [Chalkieboard](https://chalkieboard.207studio.dev/) (초키보드): an iPad lesson board app for elementary school teachers. Board writing with subject tools, PPTX and HWP lesson files opened in the app, and AirPlay to the classroom display. No personal data is collected during class. In beta on TestFlight. Support: https://chalkieboard.207studio.dev/support/ · Tester guide: https://chalkieboard.207studio.dev/beta/
- CheckyBoard: a Windows app for checking paper exams one question at a time. The teacher marks each answer, and the app makes answer sheets, splits scans into per-question boxes, and produces scores, item analysis and report cards.
- [StoneWars](https://207studio.dev/stonewars/): five in a row on a 15×15 board in 3D for iPhone, iPad and Mac, with eight stone classes and seven worlds. Preparing for App Store release.
- Ttoryeot (또렷): an HWP/HWPX document engine written in Rust. Opens Korean 한글 documents and renders them to PDF or images without 한글 installed. View only. One engine for Mac, iOS, Windows and the web. Not released yet.
